newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing Expressways seen seeking July HK listing.
newsitem.headline: Beijing Expressways seen seeking July HK listing.

text.p: Chinese toll road operator Greater Beijing Region Expressways Ltd is expected to seek a listing in Hong Kong in July, market sources said on Wednesday.

Greater Beijing is expected to come to the market as a red chip, a Hong Kong-based company with Chinese backing, and is likely to be the first China play to seek a local listing after the territory reverts to China on July 1, they said.
Greater Beijing is engaged in the development of toll expressways in China linking major cities such as Beijing, Tianjin and Shenzhen, market sources said.
Jardine Fleming is expected to be the sponsor of the issue.
Sources said the company was expected to hold a presentation for analysts later in June before it kicks off its public offering by the end of the month or in early July.
No further listing details were immediately available to the market, they said.
